"GIANT BUCKS" has gone close to two months without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About a quarter of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $1 million prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

The numbers for "GIANT BUCKS" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
1638.headline: Top prizes have lasted so far

1639.body:
Of the unclaimed prize money on "JUMBO BUCKS", most is in wins under $1,000. The game is a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. That is neither good nor bad, only how it was designed. Choose the kind of game that fits the win you want.

The numbers for "JUMBO BUCKS" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
1639.headline: Where the prize money is

1640.body:

The numbers for "MEGA BUCKS" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.

1644.body:

Every line of MONEY ROLL's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.

1645.body:
"BLACK PEARLS" has joined the Florida lineup at $5 with four top prizes of $1 million. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

Everything above about "BLACK PEARLS" comes from the Florida Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.

1647.body:
"$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT" is new from the Florida Lottery. It is a $30 game with two top prizes of $15 million. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

How far "$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT" is through its run does not decide anything by itself. It changes how closely to look at the other numbers.

Every line of $15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
